summary: Frontend batch verification for Hi Tours: Singapore planner (desktop + mobile), customer reviews (Singapore/Laos/Egypt), header search overlay, sale banner, /our-office page, Thailand itinerary planner, and lead POST. All 9 feature groups PASS.

singapore_desktop_planner.sample_quote: This was our first trip abroad together and Hi Tours made it feel easy...

singapore_reviews.button_toggle_label: Show more reviews -> Show fewer reviews

thailand_itinerary_detail_planner.heading: Customize your Thailand trip
thailand_itinerary_detail_planner.quote_sample: Abhay planned our Thailand honeymoon around what we love and it showed. The Phuket sunset was pure magic...

critical_code_review_comments: Both desktop and mobile planner render simultaneously (hidden by Tailwind responsive classes). Multiple elements share data-testid like eg-planner-ratings and eg-star-row; this made our selectors ambiguous. Not a bug but consider scoping testids with -desktop/-mobile suffix for robustness.
QuoteScroller shows 12 dots which is a lot visually; UX fine but worth considering on narrow screens.
seed_data_creation: One lead was POSTed via UI with name 'QA Batch Test' (per request).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phone input selector is [data-testid="eg-planner-phone"] (direct input element). Sale banner only renders if sessionStorage key is unset; clear before testing. Both desktop and mobile planners are in DOM simultaneously - scope selectors to [data-testid="eg-planner-card-mobile"] when checking mobile layout. Thailand detail pages live at /asien/<slug> (e.g. /asien/siam-splendour-thailand).
